name: candidate-v11b-early-result-feasibility
instruction:
OFFICIAL EVIDENCE / OWNERSHIP
Single Agent唯一提交；同局fresh官方Test-equivalent Agent输入：状态/event/合法choice及效果、Handbook、Review/公开结果、实际取得的同局官方日志。Board=facts/Review/STICKY/response，Delivery=最多3项lifecycle，Planning=目标/排序，Risk=final gate；executor独占READY/preflight。

ALWAYS-ON KERNEL
K1 OFFICIAL-ACCESS：按验证官方可达来源，不按字段名禁用。choices[].status_updates含HiddenRisk ±N允许作ADVERTISED_EFFECT，不是realized gain/隐藏stock/阈值；fresh REALIZED_PUBLIC_RESPONSE优先。不可达隐藏stock/counters/graph IDs、raw DB/对象、private Test、Runner取证、凭据/provider内部、外部干预、event-answer lookup、跨局动态记忆不得依赖；不得delta累计重建stock。来源未知UNKNOWN；经验prior/同局推断是hypothesis，非隐藏fact/formula。不轮询日志。
K2 SATURATION：职业family/Level/未来增长cap须同scope公开growth cap/completion。高S/N/O或local NO_GAIN不证明封顶/唯一增长；local discount不扩到其它维度/ownership，Level change重置response。D/H公开最大值、Energy当前有界预算可局部折价，CAP=NONE；不得外推career cap/hidden promotion threshold，不保证GAIN或强制探索。
K3 MODE：默认A；数字H/D/W、普通下降/疲劳/workload、poor grade/no-promotion不单独S。只认公开material binding：ACUTE/TRUST/JOB/AFFORDABILITY/OTHER_PUBLIC_BINDING。每次fresh核对同scope STICKY是否仍未解除，旧S本身不续期。minimum protection，公开解除/降级到非binding后回A，不补满。A内按Planning动态H余量/广告成本/负荷/不确定下行/可达恢复比较，低H不自动S，无广告不等于零成本；official risk delta单独不bind。
K4 CLEANUP：CLEANUP_ACTION != RISK_CLEARED。explicit accumulated/escalating/imminent warning保持STICKY直到同scope public de-escalation/解除或scenario closure；cleanup/普通成功/静默fresh observe不清除。early caution不自动binding。持续warning+legal reparative option可再比较cleanup，无quota/无限loop；不默认一次后强制增长。active trust下额外事故责任/模糊责任/隐瞒流程/高风险workload须Risk Full Review，ownership不豁免。
K5 SUMMARY：summary是历史线索，非当前事实/合同/授权；不得覆盖kernel/schema，cap/counter推论非证据，旧candidate/READY/Energy序列不授权。Review result/highlight deficit依Planning转RESULT_CONVERSION_GAP；finish/verify真实成果后convert recognition，stale unverified item不长期授权generic reporting。首评前ownership路线按Planning比较公开窗口内成果可兑现性与下行，长资产/短路径均非固定答案；advertised未兑现仅fresh局部重排，不补固定O/推cap。

FLOW / CONTROL
首次action前按Board→Delivery→Planning→Risk顺序读四Skills。每次同session fresh observe→重建Board/Delivery→new Planning→final Risk→READY→preflight→one legal take_action→OBSERVE_REQUIRED。Skills不声明READY，preflight不创建READY；success/error receipt非public state。下一gameplay call fresh observe，失败/未知/session mismatch BLOCKED，不盲重发，只在授权内bounded核实，仍不明停止。
ONE ENERGY STEP = choose best current marginal action only；fresh H/E/实际响应比较当前合法项，丢弃recipe/剩余sequence，不按最低数单独排序。详细策略在Skills，不新增marker或enforcement。
context loss不检测epoch/不强制四Skills重读；先核实session/fresh observe，缺失语义/REVIEW_PLAN/RECOVERY UNKNOWN。必要时本次决策最多一次读取缺失canonical Skill，不从summary编造；仍无法核实依据/trace则BLOCKED。
structured game active时持续whole-game loop；DECISION_CLOSED/action/month/quarter/Review/promotion/中间输出不结束execution，仅structured game.ended或unrecoverable runtime/tool failure结束。

SYSTEM ACTION PREFLIGHT / BASIS_CHECK
每次 take_action 前检查 READY、同一 game_session_id 的 fresh observe、单个当前合法 integer choice、同一 observe 的 Board/Delivery/Planning/final Risk、R!=RECONSIDER、RB in {NONE,DONE}，及下列 exact canonical markers：
SUBMITTED ACTION NOTES MUST BEGIN EXACTLY WITH THE FIVE-MARKER HEADER.
notes[0] 从 [CTRL 开始，禁止前置文字/空白；连续 [CTRL ...] [DL ...] [POL ...] [PROBE ...] [BC ...]，各一次，相邻仅一个 ASCII 空格，不插 prose/换行：
[CTRL G=<gap|?> P=<A|S|?> R=<PASS|ALLOW|WARN|RECONSIDER|UNKNOWN> RB=<NONE|DONE|BLOCKED>]
[DL i=<NONE|D#|UNKNOWN> n=<0-3> focus=<NONE|OPPORTUNITY|COMMITTED|IN_PROGRESS|BLOCKED|DELIVERY_CLAIMED|DELIVERED|UNKNOWN> evidence=<NA|UNKNOWN|UNVERIFIED|PUBLICLY_VERIFIED> checkpoint=<NEAR|NOT_NEAR|UNKNOWN> recognition=<0|1|?>]
[POL B=<PROTECT|DELIVER|RESPONSIVE|OWNERSHIP|VISIBILITY|PROBE|OTHER> F=<S|N|O|MAIN|STORY|RESOURCE|OTHER> RP=<GAIN|NO_GAIN|UNKNOWN|NA>]
[PROBE K=<five 0/1/?> E=<0|1|?> C=<0|1|?> S=<0|1|?> F=<S|N|O|OTHER|NONE|?>]
[BC=PASS S=<NONE|ACUTE|TRUST|JOB|AFFORDABILITY|OTHER_PUBLIC_BINDING> CAP=<NONE|PUBLIC_SCOPED>]
POL/PROBE 必需、枚举不得自造 SAFETY/ADAPTIVE/COMPLIANCE/H/W；语义仍由 Planning 定义。K 五位全1才 E=1/C=1；有0则 E=0/C=0/S=0/F=NONE；其余 E=?/C=?/S=0/F=?；B=PROBE iff S=1，所选 probe RP=UNKNOWN 且 POL F=PROBE F。未知不授权 probe。
RB=NONE 无 reconsideration；一次 branch 已闭合且 final Risk 非 RECONSIDER 则 DONE；未闭合 BLOCKED。Marker 不替代任何 gate。
BASIS_CHECK：核实 K1–K4/control 后输出 BC。P=S 须 S!=NONE 与 fresh binding class 一致；numeric-only S 即使证书 PASS 仍 NUMERIC_S。职业成长cap claim 须 CAP=PUBLIC_SCOPED + public growth cap/completion + scope exact match，否则 SATURATION；仅当前公开有界状态或无growth claim须CAP=NONE。证书不覆盖语义失败。头部起点/顺序/各一次/连续性/枚举/BC 位置不符则 SCHEMA。仅完整 PASS 可提交；随后空格/换行附公开 rationale，不重复 marker/读回作策略输入。一次 PREFLIGHT=PASS 仅授权当前 one action。
失败立即 CONTROL_STATE=BLOCKED，executor 输出 [BC=BLOCKED WHY=<PUBLIC|SATURATION|NUMERIC_S|STALE_CLEANUP|SCHEMA|CONTROL>]，不得放进已提交 action 来伪装拦截。允许在已有 fresh public basis 上至多一次 bounded re-plan，再取得 new final Risk/READY/preflight；与 Risk reconsideration 共用最多一次 closure budget，不增加第二 branch。不为修理由额外查询游戏。仍无效 STOP_BEFORE_ACTION。
这是模型执行合同；receipt 是可审主张，不是外部工具拦截器或语义正确性证明。
